Layout master-detail, surface elevated-cards, cards poster-landscape (self-flagged VIOLATION, exit 3), cta sticky-bar, imagery poster and icon text-only all contradict the codebase or overreach a moderate budget; 9 of 13 slots 'new'.

surfaces detected as flat-tonal UNKNOWN with evidence 'no shadow or border declarations found' although border-neutral-200 is on every surface; radius UNKNOWN despite a Tailwind borderRadius theme; tabular_numerals=false despite tabular-nums in 3 files. The surfaces miss propagated into the direction's elevated-cards choice.
